title: Allocation 103/105/108
caption: Supplier allocation at Sir Abe's three levels (last year's sales x 103 / 105 / 108 % / 12), planning cycle 2026-03-01, 73 products, run_lp --dry-run with every other input at its placeholder default. 103%: order 1,193,368 of need 1,255,471 pieces, shortfall 62,103 on 45 SKUs, month-end cover 3.000000 weeks (PHP -0.02 against the 3-week requirement); 105%: order 1,216,540 of need 1,255,471 pieces, shortfall 38,931 on 40 SKUs, month-end cover 3.000000 weeks (PHP -0.02 against the 3-week requirement); 108%: order 1,251,299 of need 1,255,471 pieces, shortfall 4,173 on 18 SKUs, month-end cover 3.232118 weeks (PHP +635,314.11 against the 3-week requirement).
